description: Oscillator with five waveforms available at once, among them an even wave carrying the fundamental and its even harmonics

params.text: Sets the octave in ten steps, marked as organ footage from 32 foot down to 1/16 foot
Tunes the oscillator over -7 to +7 semitones
Sets the width of the square wave, held between 5% and 95% unless the menu allows the full sweep

inputs.text: Volt-per-octave pitch, added to the other V/OCT input and to the octave and tune knobs
Exponential frequency modulation, scaled so that 4V shifts the pitch by one octave
A rising edge here restarts every waveform half way through its cycle
Modulates the width of the square wave; the voltage is divided by 5 and added to the PWM knob

outputs.text: A triangle wave, 10V peak to peak
A sine wave, 10V peak to peak
A saw at twice the fundamental mixed with a sine at the fundamental, which leaves the fundamental and its even harmonics
A sawtooth wave, 10V peak to peak
A square wave, 10V peak to peak, its width set by the PWM knob

menu: Remove DC from pulse — takes out the DC offset that an off-centre pulse width gives the square output; on by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
Oversampling — runs the waveform generation above the sample rate to cut aliasing: Off, x2, x4 or x8, with x4 the default
Limit pulsewidth (5%-95%) — holds the square wave between 5% and 95% wide; on by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
